Heat-draw: a 10 m pull aura that also drains resource while the hero is chilled. Breaks into six flickers on death.

rare_elites.look: Pallbearer whose shield is a carved stone lid with an effigy in relief; a crest of ribs stands along his helmet.
mechanics: Shield wall: spawns with three pallbearers who lock lids edge to edge with his and advance as one front that blocks all frontal damage and projectiles.
The wall opens for 4 s whenever any member is staggered or struck from behind.

rare_elites.look: Vault-dropper trailing a bridal veil of web from her hind legs; the markings on her abdomen read as a sleeping face.
mechanics: Drops, strikes and re-ascends every 6 s; each drop leaves a web patch (root 1 s on entry, lasts 10 s).
Every third drop cocoons the target (root 2.5 s, broken by damage to the cocoon); she bites cocooned targets for triple damage.

rare_elites.look: Lid-knight with a carved crown and a face that has been chiselled off; the slab on his back is the whole royal lid, twice the usual width.
mechanics: The slab makes him immune to hits from behind — the reverse of every other enemy — and he cannot be staggered.
Lid-slam: he falls flat forward, sending three crushing lines down the hall, and is vulnerable for 2 s while he gets up.

rare_elites.name_en: The Knot of a Hundred Tears
rare_elites.where: The mass grave of the unburnt
rare_elites.look: Three veiled heads on one column of shroud, with a dozen long arms.
mechanics: Fear aura, 5 m: fear 1 s every 4 s unless the hero stands in firelight or on burning ground.
Splits into three mourners at 50%, and each of those releases two lantern-ghosts when it dies.

rare_elites.look: One-eyed hearth-toad carrying three hearth-pots on its harness, the belly scarred with old burn rings.
mechanics: Swallows on a successful tongue-pull: the hero is inside for 2 s (poison, cannot act) and is then spat 8 m.
Fire ignites the belly gas: the toad bursts for 20% of its own life and is stunned 3 s — the intended counter.

rare_elites.where: Appears ahead of the hero in thick fog on the boardwalks
rare_elites.look: Lamp-bearer wearing a real traveller's hood and pack; from a distance it cannot be told from a friendly lantern-carrier.
mechanics: Neutral until attacked or until it arrives: it walks ahead through the fog, leading the hero past three clusters of dormant False Lamp-posts that wake as it passes.
At the end of the walk it turns hostile with a spore aura. Killing it early skips the ambushes but halves its loot.

rare_elites.where: The deep channel under the long boardwalk
rare_elites.look: Bone-pale elder leech; only the ring of its mouth and a line of flute-holes break the surface.
mechanics: Stays submerged except to feed: the inhale reaches 14 m and drags the hero along the boardwalk into its strike.
Sheds six weepers per 20% life lost; each weeper that feeds on the hero and returns heals it 3%.

rare_elites.where: The drying racks of the drowned village
rare_elites.look: Net-caster a head taller, one arm massively overgrown, carrying three nets and a necklace of drowned fishermen's boat-tokens.
mechanics: Throws three nets in a fan; a netted hero is hauled 6 m toward the nearest mud patch, where two peat-sleepers rise.
She re-nets the moment a root ends unless she is in melee, where she cannot throw.

rare_elites.where: The parade stair facing the fallen disc
rare_elites.look: Mirror-guard in a gilded mask; his mirror is etched with a noon sun-face.
mechanics: Reflects 100% of projectiles and beams at full damage; after three reflections the mirror overheats and flashes (60° cone, stun 1.5 s).
Open from behind, and for 3 s after a shield-bash that misses.

rare_elites.look: Rust-tail armoured in mismatched brass — helmets, a bell, a gear, breastplates — rusted together; without it, a pale soft body.
mechanics: Moults at 66% and 33%: abandons its brass (which stays as an obstacle that conducts storm strikes), turns fast and takes 40% more damage, and runs for the nearest large brass prop to re-armour.
Destroying the marked props beforehand denies it a new shell.

rare_elites.look: Storm-jar bearer carrying three jars on a frame like organ pipes, with a long white beard of wire.
mechanics: His called strikes chain to every brass object within 6 m of the impact (props, mirror-shields, sentinels, brass-hermits), so position decides the damage.
Each jar lost (at 66 / 33 / 0%) discharges a nova; the last has a 3 s telegraph.

rare_elites.look: Sun-disc thrower with twelve discs fanned on his back like a peacock's tail and the thirteenth, a huge one, in his hand.
mechanics: His discs do not return: each stays in the arena on a wide orbit round him as a moving blade hazard, up to six.
Staggering him drops every disc at once.

rare_elites.look: Chorister with a double halo, a veil twice as tall, and a conductor's rod of bone instead of the bell.
mechanics: Every 8 s she holds a rest: all allies within 14 m gain her barrier at once.
The barriers fail only while the hero stands inside her own halo — a 3 m ring on the ground that drifts away from the hero. Blinks 10 m when struck in melee (6 s cooldown).

rare_elites.look: The largest bell in the city, cracked from lip to shoulder, with two pairs of legs hanging from its mouth and an inscription band that glows white.
mechanics: Tolls three expanding rings in a row with different gaps, and each ring deletes the hero's ground effects and strips buffs from summons.
The hanging legs are a weak point (hits there build stagger); staggered, it falls and rings — stunning its own allies for 3 s.

rare_elites.look: A lit one burning from the head to the waist yet still whole, with his chandler's dipping-rack on his back like two wings of hanging candles.
mechanics: He never detonates: he sprints in long arcs leaving a trail of burning wax (6 s), and every Wax-sealed he brushes past catches fire and becomes a Lit Wick.
Only chill or freeze slows him; freezing him puts the trail out.

rare_elites.look: Snuffer in a white mask painted with a stitched mouth, a gilded snuffer cone, and tribunal scroll-ribbons pinned down her robe.
mechanics: Each snuffer hit strips one buff from the hero and drains 25% resource.

Plants the snuffer cone as a 5 m hush zone (10 s): inside it the hero's resource does not regenerate and fire effects go out, and she fights barehanded and faster while it stands. The cone can be destroyed.

rare_elites.look: Trip-hammer with a whistle-pipe on his helmet, tally-chains across the chest, and shift marks chalked on his ballast drum.
mechanics: Rings the shift-bell on his own ballast drum: every Forge-thrall within 20 m enrages for 10 s, and any thrall that dies while he lives stands back up once at 40%.
His hammer-blows send shock-lines along the floor's rails (telegraphed).

rare_elites.look: Ember-caller whose horns form two concentric rings, holding a white-gold flame.
mechanics: Summons three cinderlings every 8 s (cap 9).
At 50% it calls them all home: each cinderling that reaches it heals 4% and adds a ring to its next eruption volley — kill or freeze them on the way in.

rare_elites.where: The obsidian shelf above the void
rare_elites.look: Sound-eater whose hoop is twice as wide, with rib-walkers clinging all round its rim.
mechanics: Its absorb field is 9 m wide and lasts 4 s: every projectile in the room curves into it, and it releases what it ate as a white ring (damage scales with the count, cap ×3).
Rib-walkers pour from the hole while it inhales (two per second). Melee it, or stop shooting.

rare_elites.where: Wades the lava channel beside the causeway
rare_elites.look: Stoker-giant waist-deep in lava, using his shovel as a punt-pole, with a slag-lantern hung on a hook over his shoulder.
mechanics: Stands in the lava where melee cannot reach and flings slag in five-circle volleys.
Every 20 s he wades to the bank, scoops the hero up and throws them onto a marked island ringed by burning ground; he is then ashore and vulnerable for 8 s.

stronghold_bosses.name_en: Mog, Warden of the Broken Lamp
stronghold_bosses.look: Bloated husk in a keeper-captain's coat burst open over the belly; the beacon's last ember glows orange through the stretched skin, and the tower keys still hang at his belt.
mechanics: He swallowed the beacon's last ember rather than let it go out. He does not burst on contact: he vents a poison cloud behind him as he walks.
At 66% and 33% he ruptures (8 m poison nova, 1.5 s telegraph) and three husks climb down from the dead beacon tower.
On death the ember is freed and relights the beacon — the stronghold's liberation moment.

stronghold_bosses.look: Frost-skinned Fallen Knight in a castellan's fur mantle with an ice-sealed visor, carrying the garrison banner.
mechanics: Plants the garrison banner (destructible: 8% of his life). While it stands, Frostbound within 15 m cannot be staggered or slowed and a fresh rank of four rises every 15 s.
Breaking the banner stops the musters and makes him vulnerable for 6 s; he plants it again after 25 s.

stronghold_bosses.look: Fallen Knight wearing a barrow-warden's tabard with the key emblem scored out, and the wardens' lantern-staff, dark, across his back.
mechanics: The warden who opened the barrows to the Order. Drives his sword into the ground to draw a 7 m desecration circle (12 s): skeletons climb out of the camp's graves inside it.
Every skeleton that dies inside the circle heals him 3% — fight the dead outside the ring, or pull him out of it.

stronghold_bosses.name_en: Old Peat, Master of the Stockade
stronghold_bosses.look: Rotspawn with the stockade's palisade stakes driven through its back like spines and boardwalk planks plastered over chest and arms.
mechanics: Wears the stockade: tears up planks to plate himself (four plates, each absorbs one heavy hit and falls as debris).
Sinks into the mud and rises under the hero (4.5 m circle), leaving two peat-sleepers behind each time.

stronghold_bosses.look: Brass sentinel with a merchant's scales welded to one shoulder, a numeral plate on the chest, and a market bell where its left hand should be.
mechanics: Still enforcing closing hour. Arcs tether it to two storm-pylons at the corners of the market: while a pylon stands it has a lightning barrier that returns 30% of melee damage as shock. Destroy the pylons to earth it.
Closing bell: three arena-wide shock rings with safe gaps, repeated faster below 30% life.

stronghold_bosses.look: Fallen Knight in wax-spattered white plate, a defaced chandlers' guild banner for a cape, swinging a small cauldron of wax on a chain in his off hand.
mechanics: The barricade's edge is lined with dormant Wax-sealed: his sweeps knock the hero toward them, and any the hero touches wake and grab (root 1 s).

Seal: throws a cauldron of wax; a direct hit encases the hero (rooted until 10% of the hero's life in damage is dealt to the shell). Fire near the edge lights the sealed ones — a risk the player controls.

stronghold_bosses.name_en: Urg, Eater of the Last Embers
stronghold_bosses.look: Magma Brute with ember-crystal shards grown out of its back and a belly that glows like an open furnace.
mechanics: Six ember-crystals lie around the yard: every 12 s he lumbers to the nearest and eats it (+8% damage, larger, heals 5%, permanent). The hero can shatter crystals first.
If he eats four he overheats: a 10 m eruption, after which he is staggered and vulnerable for 6 s.

dungeon_bosses.look: A larger Huddle of seven under a kitchen tablecloth, one of them still clutching the family's hearth-pot.
mechanics: Shedding — every 15% life lost, one body peels off as a husk and the mass shrinks and speeds up (+8% move speed each). At 25% the last three split apart and must all die within 6 s of each other, or they huddle again at 20%.

dungeon_bosses.look: A hollow stump three metres across with an ember core showing through its splits, and four cinder-roots as thick as a man.
mechanics: Burn the roots — the heart-stump cannot be damaged while its four roots are underground. Roots erupt in telegraphed lines and rings; a root set alight (fire damage, or a lit Stumpling lured into it) stays up and burning for 8 s, and the heart takes damage only while at least one root burns.

dungeon_bosses.look: Standing Watch whose ice pillar encases him completely, the garrison's watch-bell frozen into it above his head.
mechanics: Thaw — his ice shell regrows completely every 10 s unless he stands in the light of one of the hall's four braziers, which the freed prisoners relight as the hero rescues them. Lure him into brazier-light to fight the man instead of the ice.

dungeon_bosses.look: Rimehorn stalker half again as large, with branching antlers of ice and a mantle of stalker pelts.
mechanics: Pillar-leaping — she leaps between the cave's ice pillars instead of walking, and every landing shakes icicles loose over a marked area. Shattering the pillar she is perched on drops her, stunned for 3 s — the only time she stays on the ground.

dungeon_bosses.look: New rigid model (Rig F): a stone sarcophagus three metres long walking on four carved lion-feet, its lid carved with a lying effigy; a bound occupant inside.
mechanics: The lid — closed, it takes 90% less damage and attacks by slam and charge. Every 14 s the lid slides open to release two wraiths, and for 5 s the occupant inside is exposed and takes full damage. Killing its wraiths quickly forces the lid open again sooner.

dungeon_bosses.look: Barrow Amalgam with four working arms, a shelf-ladder strapped to its back, and a tally-string of small skulls.
mechanics: Restocking — at 70 / 40 / 10% it walks to the nearest bone-stack and rebuilds: heals 12% and gains one more swing per combo. The stacks are destructible; a stack destroyed in advance is a heal denied.

dungeon_bosses.name_en: The Long Eel of the Drowned Cellar
dungeon_bosses.look: A pale mud-eel twelve metres long with boardwalk planks stuck in its dorsal fin.
mechanics: Rising water — the cellar floods in three stages. The eel travels and strikes only through water; standing on the shrinking dry islands forces it to breach onto land to reach the hero, where it is slow and exposed for 4 s. In water it is untargetable between strikes.

dungeon_bosses.look: Three mire-hags told apart by their hats — basket, eel-trap, reed crown — round one cauldron.
mechanics: One life, three bodies — the three share one life bar. Only the hag farthest from the hero casts (empowered volleys and rain); the nearest always sinks into the mud and re-emerges on the far side. Keeping two of them close together fixes which one is the caster — and exposes her.

dungeon_bosses.look: New static model (Rig F): a fixed brass hub five metres across at the meeting of three conveyor lines, with a heliostat arm on top.
mechanics: The assembly line — every 18 s each running line delivers a construct (key-winder, then brass-hermits, then a sentinel). Destroying a line's drive-gear jams it; with all three jammed the hub overloads and opens its core for 8 s. Its heliostat arm sweeps a beam across the floor throughout.

dungeon_bosses.name_en: Iveta, Blade-dancer of the Tomb Road
dungeon_bosses.look: Sand-revenant with twin ringed blades, ankle-bells and a long veil of linen strips.
mechanics: Sand doubles — at 75 / 50 / 25% she bursts into a sand-cloud and three dancers step out. The doubles die in one hit but burst into blinding sand (weaken, light radius dimmed 3 s). The real one is the only one whose brass rings make a sound and whose eyes glow.

dungeon_bosses.name_en: Abbess Aida of the Held Breath
dungeon_bosses.look: Chorister with a triple-arched veil and a bell on a long conductor's staff.
mechanics: Measures of rest — every 12 s she raises her bell for a two-second rest (the screen desaturates; a ring closing on the hero is the telegraph): any skill the hero uses during the rest is answered by a heavy shadow strike. Moving is allowed. She takes 50% more damage for 4 s after each rest in which nothing was cast.

dungeon_bosses.look: Tongue-bearer with a rack of stolen clappers on his back like organ pipes.
mechanics: Planted clappers — he throws clappers that stick upright in the floor (up to five). His slam makes every planted clapper emit a stun ring at once, so each one left standing multiplies the overlap. Clappers can be knocked down, or the hero can stand where the rings miss.

dungeon_bosses.look: New static model (Rig F body, Rig A rider): a bellows the size of a house with its thrall still pumping on top.
mechanics: Wind phases — it alternates 5 s of BLOW (pushes the hero toward the slag channels at the arena's edge and fans every burning patch to double size) and 5 s of DRAW (pulls the hero toward the nozzle and its tong-hand guards). The thrall on top is the only damageable part, reachable during DRAW or from the two side gantries.

dungeon_bosses.look: Fallen Knight split down the middle: the left half burning along its ember seams, the right half smooth void-white with a slot through the helm.
mechanics: Two halves — he changes stance every 15 s (the lit half shows which). FIRE: his swings leave burning ground and he takes full damage. HUSH: he puts out all burning ground, drains resource in an aura, and takes 60% less damage unless the hero stands in firelight — which only his own leftover flames or the hero's fire skills provide.
A shovel, a graveyard and everything buried in it: wide shovel sweeps with knockback, grave-hands eruptions (slow), a grave rush, unearthed husks and skeletons.
Phase 2 headstone rain; phase 3 tomb-quake shock rings.
Cold steel and a mountain's worth of winter: chilling cleaves, ice-lance fans, hailfall, glacier leap, Frostbound musters.
Phase 2 blizzard (safe only next to him); phase 3 permafrost rings.
A caster who keeps her distance and lets the dead do the walking: bolt fans, bone prison, raised dead, grave-step blinks, shadow nova.
Phase 2 spiral orbs; phase 3 ossuary rain.
She does not chase; the swamp brings you to her: root lashes, mire rain that leaves poison pools, strangleroot lines (root), spore volleys, brood calls, the devouring pull.
Phase 2 homing spore-blooms; phase 3 bog surge.
A king of brass who still rules by the glaive: 180° glaive sweeps, the tyrant's charge, storm crosses, shock rings.
Phase 2 musters brass sentinels; phase 3 sandstorm bolts.

region_bosses.name_en: Seren, Grand Preceptor of the Hush
mechanics: Bells, silence and the choir that keeps both: bell-toll rings, seeking orbs, silent beams, hush-step blinks.
Phase 2 silence fields and choir calls; phase 3 requiem spiral.
By phase three he does not stop: ashen combos, crossing slashes, void rain, rift strikes.
Phase 2 void spiral, Extinguish (safe only next to him) and fallen knights; phase 3 umbral quake at almost no global cooldown.

world_bosses.where: The Procession Field on the border road between the Wastes and the Barrows
world_bosses.look: Rig C at about ×4 (new sculpt on the beetle build): a sexton-beetle the size of a house carrying a whole burial chapel — roof, bell-cote and stacked coffins — on its back.
mechanics: Interment — undermines three large marked zones at a time; after 2 s they collapse into pits (heavy damage, root 2 s). The pits stay for the rest of the fight and shrink the arena.

Coffin-fall — shakes her load: six to ten coffins drop on marked circles; each coffin left standing opens after 10 s and releases Unburnt (grub swarms at low life). Coffins can be smashed before they open.

The Procession — she burrows completely and follows the party as a moving grave-mound for four tolls of the chapel bell on her back, erupting under the densest group on the fourth with a ring of thrown earth.

world_bosses.where: The ford of the Fuel Road, where timber from the pass met peat from the mire
world_bosses.look: Rig A at about ×4 (hauler body, new dressing): the oldest Fuel-bearer, carrying an entire toppled beacon-tower in his hod.
mechanics: Stoking throws — tree-trunks rolled down 30 m lanes and peat-bricks lobbed as circles that smoulder for 12 s (burning and slowing ground).

The straps — the hod's two shoulder-straps are separate targets, exposed for 6 s whenever he kneels to pick up a load. Breaking both drops the hod: the beacon-tower falls along a marked line (huge damage to everything, himself included) and he is staggered; he shoulders it again after 40 s.

Gathering — sweeps an open hand through a 180° arc: anyone caught is put in the hod and carried, taking damage, until the cage door is broken (5% of his life) or 6 s pass and he throws them into a marked zone.

world_bosses.where: The Plain of Noon between the brass city and the cathedral city
world_bosses.look: Unique Rig F model: the hub of the Brass Sun — concentric brass rings twelve metres across turning round a core of storm-jars — hanging in the air.
mechanics: Eclipse sweep — the disc tilts and throws a rotating 90° wedge of shadow across the arena; everywhere outside the shadow is under its focused light (burn every second). The wedge speeds up and reverses.

Storm-jars — four jars orbit the hub and arm one after another (lit numerals); the armed jar must be destroyed before its 10 s charge completes or it discharges chain-lightning across the whole arena. Destroying a jar out of turn discharges it at once.
False dawn — every 60 s it rises and charges for 6 s to "light": anyone not standing behind one of the fallen mirror-segments (each survives two dawns) takes the full-arena flash and is stunned 3 s.

world_bosses.where: The Basalt Amphitheatre above the void
world_bosses.look: Rig D at about ×5 (new sculpt on the serpent build): a white ribbon-serpent sixty metres long whose coils are part of the arena.
mechanics: The Quiet — silence zones spread from wherever its coils lie: inside them resource does not regenerate and every fire goes out. Four great braziers round the arena can be relit (2 s channel) to burn a zone back for 20 s each.

Coil — it surfaces in a closed ring round the party, its body a wall, and tightens over 10 s. One segment glows as the weak point: breaking it (6% of its life) opens the ring and staggers it; failing means crushing damage and the ring resets.

Swallowed sound — it inhales for 4 s, pulling every projectile, ground effect and summon attack in the arena into itself, then exhales them as a white cone whose size and damage scale with what it ate. Hold fire — or feed it and stand behind it.

pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_gravedigger: lantern on the shovel, grave-soil streaming from his coat.
mechanics: Open graves — every grave-hands eruption leaves an open pit for the rest of the fight (falling in roots for 2 s and hurts); a wider shovel sweep knocks the hero toward them.
Burial — at 60% and 30% he buries the hero (untargetable; dig out with eight attacks) while husks rise; headstone-rain stones stay standing as walls that block projectiles.

pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_rimelord: ice grown into a crown and a cloak of driven snow.
mechanics: Permanent blizzard — a cold meter fills whenever the hero is more than 6 m from one of three braziers; when full, the hero is frozen 3 s. His glacier leap targets the braziers and snuffs them for 15 s.
Whiteout replaces the blizzard ring: the screen fades to white for 6 s and only telegraphs and brazier-light can be seen.

pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_bishop: she has joined the Unburnt — vestments over bare bone, her own empty casket carried behind her by pallbearers.
mechanics: Three urns — she keeps her life in three urns round the nave and cannot fall below 66 / 33 / 1% until the matching urn is broken; each urn is guarded by an urn-bearer who revives her adds.
Bone prison now closes on the hero's last three positions at once.

pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_mire_mother: half submerged, crowned with false-lamp fruit.
mechanics: The tide — water rises and falls on a 30 s cycle. At high tide only the root-islands are dry and standing in water stacks poison and slow; at low tide her roots are exposed and take double damage.
The devouring pull now runs along the water's surface from any range, and her brood are elder leeches.

pinnacle_bosses.where: The throne under the dead disc
pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_sand_tyrant: his armour polished to mirror, the dead disc filling the sky behind him.
mechanics: Light and shadow — a wedge of shadow crosses the dais. In light, each glaive strike is followed by a delayed mirror-image of the same swing; in shadow, his storm crosses strike twice as often.
Two mirror-guards flank the throne and reflect projectiles until they are killed; a mask-maker re-forges them at 50%.

pinnacle_bosses.where: The silent cathedral, its bells hung with bodies
pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_grand_hush: a staff of four hanging bells, vestments white instead of black.
mechanics: The score — a visible staff of four measures loops: on rest measures any skill the hero uses is answered by a shadow strike, on toll measures his bell-toll rings come in triplets.
Two Hung Bells drift in the nave and extinguish ground effects; the choir he calls shields him, not themselves.

pinnacle_bosses.where: The first beacon, before the dusk
pinnacle_bosses.look: New humanoid duelist: a keeper in plain travelling leathers with a lantern-staff in one hand and a short sword in the other, lit warm from within — the only boss in the game who glows like the hero.
mechanics: Mirror match — the first person who ever carried ember, as the fire remembers her: she uses three skills taken from the hero's own class kit, at boss scale.

The brazier — one brazier burns in the centre; whoever stands in its light regenerates and deals 30% more damage, and she fights for it. At 40% she snuffs it herself, and the last phase is fought in the dark by the light of skills alone.

pinnacle_bosses.where: The heart of the dead Forge, lightless
pinnacle_bosses.look: Remix of boss_osaros: no longer dreaming — the pale outline seen through cracks in his armour now covers half of him.
mechanics: The dark — the arena is black except for a ring of light round the hero that shrinks while he lives and grows with every stagger. Extinguish is cast twice a phase and its safe zone moves.
Echoes — in phase 3 he calls one signature move from each of the six rungs below, in order. His hush stance drains resource; the only refills are the embers dropped when his knights die.

behaviours.trigger: Target 6–14 m away with a clear straight walkable lane (NavGrid.LineWalk) and the charger not rooted. Otherwise it fights as Melee.
behaviours.telegraph: Line from the charger along its aim, length ChargeLen (14 m), width 2 x Radius + 0.8 m, 0.8 s; facing is locked when the line appears.
behaviours.effect: Runs the lane at ChargeSpeed (14 m/s), ignoring unit separation. First contact with each hostile: 1.5x + Knock(8) + OnHit. Stops at the lane's end or a wall; hitting a wall or obstacle stuns the charger 1.2 s and makes it Vulnerable 2 s (the reward for side-stepping). 0.6 s recovery.
behaviours.cooldown: 7 s; first use 2–5 s after aggro.

behaviours.trigger: Passive guard whenever it is not winding up or recovering. Turn rate is capped at 180°/s so it can be flanked.
behaviours.telegraph: None for the guard (the raised shield is the read). Bash: none (short). Shield dash: 6 m lane, 0.6 s.
behaviours.effect: Hits arriving within ±60° of its facing deal 15% damage and never flinch it; projectiles from that arc are destroyed. Guard breaks for 2.5 s (Hit_Knockback, +25% damage taken) on any frontal hit that applies stun, freeze or knockback, or after three hits from behind. Attacks: Shield_OneShot bash (Knock 6); after blocking three hits within 4 s it answers with Shield_Dash (stun 0.5 s).

behaviours.trigger: Cycle: burrowed → emerge → surfaced → dive. Emerges when it is within 1.5 m of the target's position. With StationaryEmerge (roots) it picks a point within 2 m of the target and does not move while up.
behaviours.telegraph: While burrowed, a moving ground ripple and dust trail show where it is. Emerge: circle r 2.2 m, 0.7 s.
behaviours.effect: Burrowed: untargetable, no collision, moves at BurrowSpeed (6 m/s; blocked by walls, not by units). Emerge hit: area 1.3x + OnHit. Surfaced for SurfaceTime (5 s): attacks as Melee with its Attack1 / Attack2, takes full damage. Dives (0.5 s, still hittable) when the time is up or the target is more than 8 m away; stun or freeze delays the dive.
behaviours.cooldown: 2.5 s underground before the next emerge.

behaviours.trigger: Keeps 7–11 m like Ranged. Throws at the target's current position whenever its attack cooldown is ready; low obstacles do not block the lob.
behaviours.telegraph: Circle of BombRadius (2.4 m) at the landing point for the whole 0.9 s flight; the projectile is a visible arc.
behaviours.effect: Impact: area 1.0x + OnHit, then a GroundZone of the same radius for ZoneDur (3–5 s, per type) ticking 0.15x every 0.5 s with the zone status (burn / poison / slow). At most three live zones per bomber (oldest removed). Melee fallback: a bomber whose anim list includes a melee swing uses a Brute-style telegraphed cone when the target is inside 4 m.

behaviours.trigger: An aggro'd ally within 12 m below 70% life (lowest percentage first, never itself; HealFilter can restrict it to a family or to constructs). Moves like Support: 9–12 m from the hero, behind its allies.
behaviours.telegraph: A visible tether (smoke / beam) from healer to ally and a ring under the ally for the whole channel.
behaviours.effect: Channels 3 s, restoring 6% of the ally's max life per second (half on champions and elites, never on bosses). The channel breaks on stun, freeze, fear, flinch, death of either, or loss of line of sight. It has no ranged attack; cornered inside 3 m it uses its melee anim.

behaviours.trigger: Normal-tier monsters of ReviveFamilies (default: its own family) leave a remains marker (a small prop) for 12 s after the model dissolves. Triggers on a marker within 14 m that has not been revived before. Movement as Healer.
behaviours.telegraph: 1.5 s cast with a beam to the remains and a ring round them; broken by stun, freeze, flinch or death.
behaviours.effect: The same def stands up (LayToIdle) at 60% life as Normal tier, with no loot, 25% XP, and flagged so it cannot be revived again.

behaviours.trigger: While aggro'd, every SpawnEvery seconds (6) as long as fewer than SpawnCap (6) of its young are alive. Mobile mothers keep 8–10 m from the hero; nests have Speed 0.
behaviours.telegraph: 0.8 s Attack2 animation, with a small mark on the ground where each young will appear (within 2.5 m).
behaviours.effect: Spawns SpawnCount (2) x SpawnDef as Minion tier (no loot, 20% XP), already aggro'd. On death it releases SpawnOnDeath (3) at once. Cocoon-mother variant: lays an egg-sac prop (life = 20% of hers) that hatches three shroudlings after 4 s unless it is destroyed first.

behaviours.trigger: Aggro'd, fewer than CallCap (6) called monsters alive, cooldown ready. Moves like Caster (8–10 m); its basic attack is whatever the def has (an Eruption cast, or a melee anim when cornered).
behaviours.telegraph: 1.2 s cast (head-back wail / whistle) with a ring on the caller; broken by stun, freeze or flinch.
behaviours.effect: CallCount (3) x CallDef arrive one second later: defs that rise from the ground appear 4–8 m from the hero, others run in from off-screen. Called monsters give no loot and 25% XP. With Escort: while any escort lives the call instead gives them Enrage for 8 s, and replacements are called only when all are dead.

behaviours.trigger: Always on: one actor is one cloud. It drifts onto its target and stays overlapping it; Attract can bias target choice (flame-moths prefer burning actors and fire zones).
behaviours.telegraph: None — damage is continuous and low; the cloud itself is the read.
behaviours.effect: No collision, never flinches, immune to knockback, pull, root and bleed. Radius 1.6 m, shrinking to 0.8 m as life falls. Every 0.5 s each hostile inside takes 0.25x + OnHit, and the hero's light radius is x0.6 while inside. Damage taken: x0.35 from single-target hits and projectiles, x1.0 from area hits and ground zones, x1.5 from damage-over-time ticks.

behaviours.trigger: Immobile (Speed 0) and immune to displacement. Fires whenever the hero is inside Def.Range (16 m) with line of sight. Turns at TurnRate (60°/s), so it can be out-run round it.
behaviours.telegraph: Attack1: line of Def.Range x 1.6 m for 1.2 s; the aim locks at 0.9 s. Attack2 (per type, when the hero is within 4 m): cone or cloud, 0.8 s.
behaviours.effect: Attack1: beam or bolt 1.0x + OnHit along the line. Attack2: per type (flash stun, spore cloud, ember fan). Shutter option (forge-eye): between attacks it is shut and takes 30% damage; it is open for the wind-up and 1.5 s after firing.

behaviours.trigger: Orbits the target at 7–9 m. Swoops when the cooldown is ready, the target is 5–12 m away and NavGrid.LineShot is clear.
behaviours.telegraph: Line from the flyer through the target, 11 m x 1.6 m, 0.6 s.
behaviours.effect: Moves over low obstacles and through other units (LineShot instead of LineWalk; full walls still block). Hover height 1.6–2.4 m is cosmetic: it is always targetable, but ground zones do not affect it. Swoop: flies the lane at 16 m/s, every hostile on it takes 1.0x + OnHit; it ends 3 m past the target and hangs low for 0.5 s. With Trail it drops three zones along the lane; with Dormant(ceiling) it starts roosting.

behaviours.trigger: Stealthed while it is neither attacking nor revealed: model at 12% alpha with a shimmer, ignored by auto-targeting and minions (area damage still hits). Circles toward a point 6–8 m behind the hero. Pounces when it is 5–10 m away and outside the hero's front 120° arc, or after 4 s of stalking regardless.
behaviours.telegraph: It becomes visible and a circle (r 2.2 m) appears on the target for 0.6 s.
behaviours.effect: Leaper jump; the landing is an area hit of 1.5x plus its opening-strike status. It then fights visibly as Melee for 5 s. Any damage reveals it for 3 s; it re-stealths 8 s after a pounce once it has not been hit for 2 s.

behaviours.trigger: Spawns inactive in one of three modes. buried: invisible apart from a faint mound or bubbles, untargetable. statue: visible as a prop or statue, takes 20% damage, shows no health bar. ceiling: not drawn, a faint thread or shadow on the floor. Wakes when the hero comes within WakeRadius (5.5 m; statue 4.5 m), when its pack is aggro'd, or (statue) when it is damaged.
behaviours.telegraph: Circle r 2 m for 0.6 s at its own position (ceiling: at the hero's position) while it plays Spawn or LayToIdle.
behaviours.effect: Its first attack follows at once at 1.3x with the listed waking status; after that it behaves as its AI kind.

behaviours.trigger: Target at 4–9 m with line of sight.
behaviours.telegraph: Line to the target, 9 m x 1.0 m, 0.6 s.
behaviours.effect: The first hostile on the line takes 0.6x and is pulled to 1.5 m in front of the attacker (St.Pull) with the listed slow or root; the attacker's attack cooldown is cut to 0.3 s so that a blow follows.

behaviours.trigger: Target inside melee reach.
behaviours.telegraph: Cone 70°, reach + 1 m, 0.7 s, in a colour distinct from ordinary swings.
behaviours.effect: On a hit the hero is rooted and carried for HoldTime (1.2–2 s), taking 0.3x every 0.5 s. The hold ends early if the grabber takes 8% of its max life or is stunned. Giants finish by throwing the hero (Knock 12; 0.8x on landing in a marked circle).

behaviours.trigger: Target inside the cone length (7 m) with line of sight. On Caster and Ranged kinds it replaces the projectile attack (preferred distance 0.7 x cone length); on other kinds it is a special used at 4–9 m.
behaviours.telegraph: Cone 7 m x 50°, 0.8 s; the direction is locked when it appears.
behaviours.effect: Channels 2 s in four ticks; each tick 0.35x + OnHit along the cone (chill stacking to a freeze on the fourth tick, or knockback 3 per tick, or weaken — per type). The user stands still while blowing; stun or freeze interrupts it.

behaviours.trigger: Replaces a caster's projectile: used whenever the attack cooldown is ready and the target is inside Def.Range.
behaviours.telegraph: Circle r 2.2 m under the target's current position, 0.9 s.
behaviours.effect: Area 1.1x + OnHit at the mark. With ZoneDur set it leaves a zone (ash-fall 6 s: weaken and slow).

behaviours.trigger: Always, until broken.
behaviours.telegraph: The shell is a visible outer layer with its own bar segment.
behaviours.effect: ShellHp = ShellMul x MaxLife (1.0 for the Standing Watch). While it lasts, damage goes to the shell, the monster cannot be displaced or flinched and moves at 80% speed. Fire deals triple damage to ice shells. The shell does not regrow (boss variants excepted). When it breaks: burst FX and a 1 s stagger.

behaviours.trigger: Its first death only.
behaviours.telegraph: The body falls into a visible ash pile (targetable, 1 life) for 4 s.
behaviours.effect: Striking the pile destroys it: normal loot and XP. Left alone, the monster stands up again (LayToIdle) with 50% life, and its second death is final. Loot and XP are granted only on the final death. No pile is left if it dies frozen or standing in a frost zone (the ash sets hard).

behaviours.trigger: It takes fire damage or enters burning ground.
behaviours.telegraph: It visibly catches: flame FX, emissive seams, it lights its surroundings.
behaviours.effect: Lit for the rest of its life: move speed x1.4, attack speed x1.2, its hits apply the listed burn, and it loses 4% of its max life per second. A lit death leaves a 2 s ember patch. Chill or freeze puts it out.

behaviours.trigger: Passive while alive.
behaviours.telegraph: A ring drawn on the ground at the aura radius (8 m for buffs, 5 m for hostile auras).
behaviours.effect: Per type. Cage-bearer: allies +25% move and attack speed; on death it drops a stolen ember (pickup: 25% resource and +15% damage for 10 s). Key-winder: constructs +20% attack speed. Brazier-hulk: chill 0.3 on hostiles within 5 m. Crowned Colony: weaken 0.25 on hostiles within 5 m.

behaviours.trigger: Death.
behaviours.telegraph: The body visibly comes apart for 0.4 s before the pieces stand.
behaviours.effect: Spawns SplitCount x SplitDef round the corpse as Normal tier with half XP and no loot. The Huddle: three husks. Drift-colossus: three ash-casts (these cannot Reform). Elder Leech: four weepers.

behaviours.trigger: Death (not expiry). The pack-mule also bursts at the end of a charge that connected.

behaviours.telegraph: none (the hit itself)
behaviours.effect: Removes DrainPct (10%) of the hero's maximum class resource. Types listed as healing themselves also recover 5% of their max life per hit. No effect on minions. True silencing of skills is deliberately not used anywhere in the regular roster.

behaviours.effect: Within the attack's area: removes fire ground zones (the hero's included), clears burn from its allies, and prevents new fire zones there for 2 s.

behaviours.effect: On hit: 0.4x and the listed root (the hero can still attack while rooted). On a miss it leaves a net or web patch (r 1.6 m, 5 s, slow 0.4).

behaviours.effect: The ally gains a Brass Mask for 12 s: it takes 40% less damage and cannot be flinched, and a masked ally that falls is raised once at 40% life. The mask is visible on the model.

behaviours.effect: Hits arriving within the front 120° deal 50% damage. No projectile blocking and no bash; hits from the side or behind, ground zones and damage-over-time are unaffected.

behaviours.effect: Projectiles blocked by the guard are sent back at their owner at 50% damage instead of being destroyed.

production.title: On disk today
production.what: The 14 models already built. They cover 15 type ids because the cinderling (`imp`) is `mon_fiend` at 0.6 scale.

production.title: Finish the 17, then every variant of an existing base
production.what: First the three planned models that are not on disk yet (`mon_mire_hag`, `mon_rotspawn`, `mon_brass_sentinel`). Then all variants whose base body already exists — skeleton, husk, cultist / priest, wraith, frostbound, sand-revenant, fiend — which need new parts on an existing body builder and no new sculpt. This is the cheapest stage per type and it completes the role sets of seven of the eight current families; the cinderling gets its own model here.

production.title: Human-sized Rig A bases
production.what: Fourteen new sculpts covering every new family that has human-sized members; eight of them unlock the variants of stage 3. After this stage every region has at least one new signature family on screen.

production.title: Variants of the stage-2 bases
production.what: Fifteen variants (weapon, headgear, proportions, materials on a stage-2 body). Completes the Ember-takers and most role sets of the new Rig A families.

production.title: Rig A bruisers and giants
production.what: Twelve oversized bases (one bruiser per family that has one), three giant bases, and the three Fuel-bearer variants. Rig A is complete after this stage: 83 types.

production.title: Rig F (rigid / floating)
production.what: The cheapest new rig — no deformation, at most a hinge, a gimbal or a swarm shader — and its seven creatures touch all seven regions (lantern-ghosts, flame-moths, the three turrets, flickers, the hung bell). Build it first among the new rigs.

production.title: Rig B (quadruped)
production.what: One skeleton, three body builds (light hound, heavy boar, sprawler). Eleven creatures; gives every region its beasts and the Ash-handler his hounds.

production.title: Rig C (arthropod)
production.what: One skeleton, four body builds (beetle, spider, scorpion, hermit-crab). Fifteen creatures, the largest pay-off of any new rig: the arthropod members of three families (sexton-beetles, shroud-weavers, brass-hermits) plus three singles.

production.title: Rig D (serpentine)
production.what: One spine-chain skeleton, two builds (serpent, thick worm). Seven creatures; completes the mire and gives the burrower role its proper bodies.

production.title: Rig E (flyer)
production.what: One skeleton with three wing builds (feathered, membrane, insect). Six creatures; last because flyers are garnish everywhere and the core of no family.

production.title: Named content
production.what: Dressing passes on existing bodies for the 28 rare elites, 7 stronghold bosses and 11 of the 14 side-dungeon bosses; three new rigid side-dungeon models (the Walking Sarcophagus, the Workshop Hub, the Great Bellows); four world bosses (one each on rigs C, A, F, D at ×4–5 scale); one new pinnacle model (the First Lamp-keeper) and remix dressings for the seven region bosses.
